scene.codegen: block merge and animation fusion on

interpretation: Animation interpretation remains the highest named guest-PC residency after low-detail fighter tables and targeted fusion. Rendering, material and effects work is spread across functions rather than one removable general-emulator feature.
limits: PC is the last committed guest instruction and samples include host waits; counts do not give exact self-time or a guaranteed FPS gain. Profiling itself reduces FPS and is not an acceptance run. Symbol map was added only to a new ignored private lab release on port 3276; the ordinary static release does not need it.
